authority.document: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.4.1, 20.4.2, 20.4.6, 20.4.7 and 20.4.52

scope: Locally generated two-element AC1012 source/destination pair: model and paper BLOCK/ENDBLK body, exact handle roles, boundaries and corresponding BLOCK_HEADER identities.
checks: A shared-bit-reader observer binds all eight CRC-checked frames, complete common fields, BLOCK names, mode, null extension and neighbor links, hard-pointer LAYER 0x10, exact data/handle boundaries and trailing padding. Every byte-prefix truncation and each handle-role mutation is rejected; the same original frame passes again.

The existing BLOCK_HEADER source and role observer additionally checks model BLOCK 0x24 and ENDBLK 0x25, paper BLOCK 0x21 and ENDBLK 0x22, and model first/last LINE 0x2C. The two sample checks and the shared relative-handle vector pass.

Independent cadkit-dwg 0.5.4 decodes the source model BLOCK and ENDBLK with valid CRC, mode 2, layer 0x10, scale 1, visibility and null neighbors; its BLOCK body names *MODEL_SPACE. Cadkit is specification-directed and labels R13 untested.

The populated-pair packager reuses the observer and records four per-drawing frame hashes. A corrupted source is rejected without publishing a packet; corrected input succeeds at the same destination. The source-release inventory includes the new observer and its check and self-test pass. No drawing fixture was committed.
limits: Only the selected generated R13 source profile is checked. It does not establish whole-file graph closure, AutoCAD normal-open, dictionary cloning behavior, native output or general support.
